optimizer: nonnegative least squares, column normalized, relative-joule squared loss; no intercept outside base-time coefficient, penalty search or target-label selection
constant_fit: arithmetic mean of measured calibration power on the same 24 fit windows
scope: Blackwell GPU 1 pilot; only calibration labels; no target runtime used to fit energy coefficients
on_failure: retain all raw failures and reject the profile; no row deletion, retry, regularization search or new acquisition without a revised preregistration
